description: A CREATE TABLE column DEFAULT must be coercible to the column's type, directionally: numeric/datetime families refuse a string literal, string families refuse a numeric one, each takes the other kind; TRUE/FALSE/NULL cross every family; OBJECT/ARRAY/GEOGRAPHY judge nothing; BINARY takes no default at all in its own sentence; a cast retypes the default; computed defaults are judged by their expression type; temporal defaults widen (DATE reaches TIMESTAMP) but never narrow, VARCHAR refuses every temporal while BOOLEAN/NUMBER/VARIANT take one. All live-measured. Converted 1:1 from ddl/ColumnDefaultTypeMatchTest (now retired).
